air-baron.specific_finding: The summary tells a player to purchase/invest before collecting income and defines market share as the percentage of all spokes owned. Köther’s detailed reference instead orders the turn as optional fare-war declaration, two profit-marker draws and then one action. The original designer Evan Davis (The General30-6, printed/PDF23) independently explains two draws and market share awarded by hub dominance/control, with full control worth double dominance. The original board prints different weighted values for different hubs. Buying before the draws changes available cash and profit eligibility; replacing weighted hub values with a spoke percentage changes the central victory calculation. Specific MAJOR for covered turn order/market share only. Full manual, setup and player-count-specific targets remain missing; no full audit or body repair.
